transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Your Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well, I guess what brings me in is… late at night, I’ll start picking at leftovers, and then it’s like part of me is saying, “That’s enough, Alejandro,” but I just keep reaching for more anyway. It feels like I’m not really in control once I get started.
How often does this happen — this pattern of not feeling in control and continuing to eat even when you know you should stop?
I’d say it’s at least once most weeks. Sometimes it’s more like two nights in a week. Looking back, it’s been going on since my cousin moved in.
Do you feel upset, guilty, or embarrassed about this pattern of eating?

Yes. I feel embarrassed about it. That’s why I wait until the house is quiet, or sometimes I’ll go out to the garage. I don’t want my cousin or anyone in the family seeing how much I’m eating, especially when I’m supposed to be the disciplined one.
When you find yourself eating like this, would you say you’re eating a much larger amount of food than most people would eat in a similar period of time?

Yes… on those nights, it’s definitely more than most people would eat. Like after supper, if I’m putting away tamales or mole, I might end up having several extra servings, and then pan dulce too. I usually do it in the garage because I know it’s way more than I’d ever put on my plate in front of the family.
After these episodes of eating, do you ever make yourself vomit, use laxatives, or exercise a lot to try to compensate or control your weight?
I don’t really know what to say there… I haven’t noticed myself doing anything like that afterward. I usually just feel bad about it and try to move on.
During these times when you're eating more than usual, do you feel like you can't stop eating or control what you're eating, even if you want to?

Yes. Once I start picking at the leftovers late at night, it’s like part of me is saying, “That’s enough, Alejandro,” but I still keep reaching for more. I want to stop, but in the moment I don’t feel like I’m really in control of it.
Do you usually eat these larger amounts of food in secret because you're embarrassed about how much you're eating?

Yes. I usually wait until the house is quiet, or I’ll go out to the garage. I don’t want my cousin or the family seeing how much I’m eating. It’s embarrassing, especially because I’m supposed to be the disciplined one.
